title: Fundraiser
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office prepares for a fundraiser sponsored by Robert California to support local dog shelters. Ryan reacts emotionally to a false report of Smokey Robinson's death, while Dwight warns about a potentially dangerous ex-employee, Andy, who is attending the event despite recent tensions. Andy enthusiastically promotes his rock opera and offers to adopt all the older therapy dogs. Senator Lipton shows interest in Oscar's passion for animal causes, and a misunderstanding arises involving Angela's husband hitting on Oscar. Dwight wins all the fundraiser prizes and delivers a critical speech about the event's focus on money. Meanwhile, Nellie hopes to improve her friendship with Darryl, and Kevin humorously discusses his dog's poor condition. The episode ends with unresolved questions about Andy's emotional state and the outcomes of various interactions at the fundraiser.
